      Report EoDB Issues

      Facing an issue with an approval, NOC, licence or regulation? Tell us.

      You can report any ease of doing business issue, big or small. This includes delays, unclear or outdated rules, repeated paperwork, inspections, and compliance or filing burdens. What you share helps us suggest simpler, clearer rules that work better for businesses and government alike.

      • Anonymous unless you choose to add contact details
      • Takes about 2 minutes

      Thank you. We have received your report.
